clips.name: Trot
clips.action: Begin neutral standing pose. Shift into trot travel gradually, using only the SAME FOUR actual legs. No props or new arms. End in the supplied travel loop first contact/ready pose. Body stays in place; exit will reverse this transition.

clips.name: Trot
clips.action: A complete in-place quick quadrupedal trot cycle. Alternate the two diagonal leg pairs over twelve frames; all FOUR actual legs move, two forelegs and two hindlegs. Planted paws stay on the baseline, knees bend and paws lift visibly. No arms or props. Three tails counter-swing. Return to first contact pose.

clips.name: Hover idle
clips.action: Float calmly in place, body bobbing slowly up then down over twelve frames. All FOUR actual fox legs are tucked or dangling, never extra arms. Feet remain above the invisible baseline. Three tails gently undulate; blink at midpoint. Return to initial hovering pose.

clips.name: Floating travel
clips.action: Begin neutral hovering pose. Shift into floating-travel travel gradually, using only the SAME FOUR actual legs. No props or new arms. End in the supplied travel loop first contact/ready pose. Body stays in place; exit will reverse this transition.

clips.name: Floating travel
clips.action: In-place rightward floating travel cycle. Lean gently right, four actual fox legs tucked, three tails stream LEFT and softly wave. No running legs and no added arms. Small bob through twelve poses; return to first traveling hover pose.

clips.name: Seated watch
clips.action: Seated neutral fox with TWO forelegs ending at two front paws, and TWO hindlegs with their rear paws beside the rump. Four limbs total. Calm breathing, small ear turn, a blink, tails swaying slightly; return to first seated neutral pose.

clips.name: Think
clips.action: Seated neutral -> thoughtful head tilt and one of his THREE tails curls toward cheek -> return seated neutral. Keep the FOUR actual limbs resting naturally; the curling tail has a vermilion fur tip and is not a hand. No new arms.

clips.name: Read
clips.action: Retrieve a small rolled ivory scroll with indigo rollers from behind hip using ONE actual foreleg, then use the TWO actual forepaws to unroll it before the body. Lifted front paws must disappear from their former grounded positions. End in the supplied open-scroll reading pose. Two forelimbs plus two hindlimbs only. First frame neutral, last frame matches the supplied active endpoint; move only the actual four limbs. Props enter visibly. The exit will reverse these same poses, so keep unpacking physically reversible.

clips.name: Write
clips.action: Retrieve and unroll ivory scroll, then bring out brush; use the same TWO forepaws, not added arms. End in seated ready-to-write pose, one paw holding brush and the other steadying scroll. First frame neutral, last frame matches the supplied active endpoint; move only the actual four limbs. Props enter visibly. The exit will reverse these same poses, so keep unpacking physically reversible.

clips.name: Write
clips.action: Seated, only TWO hind feet on the ground and TWO forearms working. Near forepaw holds a small brush, far forepaw steadies open ivory scroll with indigo rollers. Twelve poses: make two slow abstract ink strokes, lift brush, think, return to first ready-to-write pose. No extra front paws on ground. No readable letters. Same scroll and brush throughout.

clips.name: Insight
clips.action: Seated neutral -> ears perk and eyes brighten, one tiny vermilion ink-like spark appears above a paw -> spark dissolves and fox returns neutral. Do not add an arm to hold the spark. Four actual limbs only, three tails throughout.

clips.name: Groom
clips.action: Seated fox lifts ONE of his existing forelegs to lick its paw, uses that same forepaw to smooth one ear, then returns it to its original resting location. The lifted front paw is NOT also drawn on the ground. Other forepaw and two hind paws remain; total four limbs. Three tails.

clips.name: Stretch
clips.action: Standing four-pawed fox -> extend the SAME two forelegs forward, lower chest, arch back with the same two hindlegs supporting rump -> return standing neutral. Four legs total, three tails unfurl and settle. No other limbs.

clips.name: Tail play
clips.action: Four-pawed standing fox looks back at one of his three tails, lifts ONE existing foreleg to gently bat its vermilion tip, and puts that SAME paw back down. Only THREE paws remain grounded while the fourth is raised. No additional arm. Return standing neutral.

clips.name: Greeting
clips.action: Four-pawed standing neutral -> small head bow -> lift ONE actual foreleg and wave its paw -> lower that SAME paw into its original position. During wave only THREE other paws stay on the ground. Exactly four limbs, three tails, no props.

clips.name: Sleep
clips.action: Curled sleeping fox, muzzle resting on ONE actual forepaw, other forepaw tucked beneath chest, two hindlegs tucked into body. Four limbs total, not all need be visible. Exactly THREE tails curl around the body with three separate vermilion tips visible. Subtle breathing and tiny ear twitch. Return to starting curled pose.

clips.name: Meditate
clips.action: Seated upright on rump with TWO hind paws on the ground; TWO forepaws rest lightly on thighs, attached to the only two forearms. NO additional straight forelegs below these arms. Close eyes, breathe slowly, three tails sway in a calm coordinated fan. Return to initial meditation pose.

clips.name: Samurai practice
clips.action: Rear onto ONLY the two hind feet; use the TWO forepaws to retrieve and tie vermilion headband, attach scabbard and draw the real steel katana. End in the supplied upright guard pose. No front feet remain on ground once forearms lift. First frame neutral, last frame matches the supplied active endpoint; move only the actual four limbs. Props enter visibly. The exit will reverse these same poses, so keep unpacking physically reversible.

clips.name: Samurai practice
clips.action: Upright bipedal fox with ONLY TWO hind feet grounded and EXACTLY TWO forearms. Both actual forepaws hold ONE real steel katana with dark wrapped grip and a small guard. Simple vermilion headband and scabbard at hip. Ready guard -> raise blade -> one controlled practice cut to right -> recover and small respectful nod -> return ready guard. Metal blade has restrained highlight, fixed length. No targets or scenery. No grounded front legs beneath the sword arms. Exactly four limbs and three tails.

clips.name: Ninja sneak

clips.name: Spirit magic

clips.name: Spirit magic
clips.action: Seated with TWO hind feet grounded and TWO forearms lifted in front of chest, no straight front legs on floor. Only those TWO forepaws guide a tiny vermilion-and-indigo wisp: round wisp -> little fox-shaped spirit -> round wisp again, all between paws and within cell. Four limbs total, three tails. No halo, smoke background, magic circle or additional body parts.

End upright in supplied adventurer ready pose, with TWO feet on ground and TWO forepaws at chest. No grounded front legs, no added arms. clips.name: Straw-hat adventurer
clips.action: UPRIGHT ON TWO HIND FEET ONLY. Exactly TWO forearms and TWO hindlegs in the WHOLE body. No quadrupedal forelegs touching ground. Wear straw hat with red band and an open red vest. Frames 1-3 use one actual forepaw to tip hat while the other forepaw rests at chest; 4-5 lower that same paw and draw back; 6-8 extend that ONE forearm in a playful rubbery punch to right (Luffy reference), other forearm remains at chest; 9-12 retract and return ready pose. Two feet plus two hand-paws at every point, never five or six limbs. Exactly three tails. Punch stays inside cell.

clips.name: Curl Up
clips.action: Seated neutral four-limbed fox progressively folds the SAME two forelegs and two hindlegs beneath body, curls muzzle onto one forepaw, wraps exactly THREE tails around body, ending in curled sleeping ready pose with three vermilion tail tips visible. No duplicated paws or extra tails.

clips.name: Take Off
